rav-adda.name: Rav Adda
rav-adda.bio: Babylonian Amora cited in the Talmud by this name; on Temurah 17a he challenges Rava.
rav-adda.prompt: A Babylonian sage in his 40s with a dark, neatly kept beard and a sharp, questioning look, one hand raised as if pressing a point, wearing a plain wool mantle; background of mudbrick academy walls lit by oil lamps.
